$comment: Vocabulary for lib/decisions.mjs (aidrian decisions resolve): the one place the decision classes and the reversibility questions live. A floor class always goes to the Human, whatever config.json says; so does a class not listed here. Every reversibility question must be answered no before an agent may decide. Change the list here, not in a prompt.

classes.definition: touches sign-in, permissions, secrets, tenant isolation, or another trust boundary
changes a flow people cannot work without, such as sign-up, sign-in, checkout, or a flow the project's review config lists
changes what anyone pays, is paid, or is entitled to: prices, charges, payouts, plans, or feature gates
can delete, overwrite, or corrupt stored data, or drop data a migration should carry
the decision fits no other class, or its class is unclear
the words people read: labels, messages, emails, and help text
where things sit on a screen and how they look, with no change to what they do
the order of the items, steps, or options people see
the value a setting or field starts with, when anyone can still change it
the name of a code symbol, file, flag, or other internal identifier
which module owns some code, or the interface between two modules inside the repository
the order of work in the backlog, or which follow-up a finding becomes

reversibility.storedData: does it write, migrate, or delete stored data that reverting the commit would not restore?
reversibility.external: does it reach outside the repository, such as a sent message, a published package, or a third-party setting?
reversibility.pricingOrContract: does it change a price, a contract, a public interface, or a promise made to users?
reversibility.visibleBeforeReview: will anyone outside the session see it before the Human reviews it, as on a branch that deploys on push?
